reviews.author: Steve Holt
reviews.text: C&C does great work and are very knowledgeable about vehicle and small engine repairs. I've known them and done business with them since 2000. Give them an opportunity to repair your vehicle. I'm satisfied with their work! - S. Holt, Spartanburg, SC

reviews.author: Hanna Hawkins
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this shop. They fixed my car quickly and got me back on the road sooner than I expected. The service was efficient, honest, and reasonably priced. It’s hard to find a mechanic you can trust, but these guys definitely earned mine. I’ll be coming back and recommending them to others.

reviews.author: Jocelyn Barry
reviews.text: Charles and Dave are honest people motivated to help cars ride safely. Their rates are very competitive, lower than most per hour. They go the extra mile. For example, they picked up my car and returned it after checking it over. Second, they saved me $400 by having another place look over my alternator that was under performing. They improved the alternator's performance, so I am good to charge my battery. Other places would probably just charge me to put in a new alternator. It is hard to find honest mechanics. I recommend trying them out.

reviews.author: Tia Daniels
reviews.text: Charles and Dave are amazing! We have had 2 cars have odd issues occur and Charles went over and beyond for us. He is great with updates, quick to respond, honest and fair. I highly recommend this shop!!! Definitely going to continue to bring my vehicles to him!

reviews.author: Joel Lynn
reviews.text: Did an awesome job on my Ford F-350. Charles and his crew checked the truck over and found it was just the carrier bearing. Also charged a/c up and is working as always. Thanks for the great job. If needed will go back to Charles and crew.

reviews.author: Bella Russell
reviews.text: Great service, I took my car here after the dealership tried to tell me it'd be over 2k to fix my car and said i needed to replace my cooler, turns out that wasn't the case and they just wanted to make more money out of me. C&C got the job done for a fraction of the price and didn't try and waste my money. Great communication throughout the whole process, im very grateful to have found them when i did, i will most definitely be a returning costumer! Thank you guys!

reviews.author: Christian Parris
reviews.text: Dude man had cars in his shop and took his time out of his day to hear me out when no other shop would told me.He wouldn't charge me a diagnosing fee if it didn't take too long and I cannot explain enough how much that meant to me i'm pretty experienced in working on cars, but I usually work on cars that are Thirty years or older and i was asking about a prius. And Even though cars were in his shop he was having to work on, he spent about 30 minutes talking with me. And told me that i knew what I was talking about. And he would have no problem fixing the issue. But he personally wanted to diagnose it first without a charge. As long as it didn't take too long. I'm bringing all my vehicles to him from now on. I've been looking for an old school mechanic for a long time. And Now, i have the guy!!!!

reviews.author: Cary Massaro
reviews.text: Always professional service and very fair pricing ! No need to take your automotive repairs anywhere else ! Thank you C & C Customs ! Can't wait for Charles and Cody to start on my 1974 Ford truck !

reviews.author: Kathryn Hines
reviews.text: This is the shop if you want honest, dependable, trustworthy automotive work!!! Charles, Dave and Cody are professionals and truly care about your car and the trials that other so-called mechanics have put you through, like another mechanic putting in a filthy AC filter in to make my AC not cool when I told them that I’d be taking my car to C and C. Charles and Dave fixed me right up! These are the guys to trust with your car and safety!!

reviews.author: Ali Griffis
reviews.text: They are Awesome! My husband got his diesel truck in right away and got it back in two days. They fixed what was wrong and didn’t invent services we did not need! The price was lower than anyone else in town. Good Christian people who will treat you right! Go see them!

reviews.author: Lee Nanney
reviews.text: Charles Womack and his staff are very knowledgeable and do quality work. They carefully look for solutions instead of trial and error like a lot of garages. They also explain in detail what is wrong and how they are going to fix it. I highly recommend their services.

reviews.author: addison sloan
reviews.text: Charles and his crew did some front suspension repair on my truck. Great communication and timely service. You get what you pay for and they significantly improved my truck. Great folks

reviews.author: Lori Matti
reviews.text: Charles the owner and his staff are absolutely wonderful and extremely knowledgeable and helpful. They are all very professional and absolutely kindhearted people. Highly recommend them for any automotive repairs.

reviews.author: Jeka Gannotskiy
reviews.text: My second time taking my van to C & C Kustoms for repairs and I am really happy with their service. Charles and David do an amazing job and the prices are very fair. Charles will stay in contact with you throughout the whole process, letting you know what needs to happen to get you back on the road all the while saving you money by not doing unnecessary services. You will never be in the dark with C & C Kustoms. Having a good mechanic is like having a doctor you can trust. I will definitely be coming back for all my repairs. -Eugene

reviews.author: Jessica Early
reviews.text: Such a great experience. Called the previous day, dropped my car off the next morning and it was ready with in 3 hours. Very good on pricing and honest when relating issues. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Morgan Mortimer
reviews.text: Very trustworthy!!! I have gone to a few different mechanics over the last few years for my van & Charles made me feel very comfortable leaving my vehicle with them & they were very respectful with the limited time window I have off to get my van fixed. They aren’t out here looking to take all your money… they genuinely want to help people who have car problems. 10/10 recommend - they will always get my services when needed!!!!!

reviews.author: Nicholas Dowis
reviews.text: Recently had nissian of greer price replacing a lower control arm. Their price was out of this world high. Went over to the people at C&C customs and was able to have both the uppers and lowers on both sides replaced, new struts and all around shocks for the same price that nissian wanted for one control arm.

reviews.author: Nicole Davila
reviews.text: Five stars all the way! This shop went above and beyond to take care of our vehicle. Honest, reliable, and incredibly thorough. You can tell they genuinely care about their customers. We won’t go anywhere else!

reviews.author: Lashaun Frazier
reviews.text: I had the best experience on New Year’s Eve. Prompt service, personable, and pleasant conversation. The owner and his son have earned my trust and I will do business with them again. Affordable price range as well. Family friendly is hard to find. Appreciate you guys!

reviews.author: Andre Honeycutt
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of meeting Charles at C and C Kustoms Automotive. He asked good questions and took the time to listen to my concerns with my vehicle. He took the time to thoroughly investigate the source of the weird noise my vehicle was making. I was impressed with his sincerity, his humble attitude and his professional diagnosis. I can definitely recommend him!

reviews.author: Savannah Higdon
reviews.text: They did an amazing job with my car. They had it done very quickly and fixed everything I didnt even know was wrong. Would absolutely bring my car back to them ever time!

reviews.author: Ralph Comer
reviews.text: Our family has been using C&C Custom through the years. Charles does an excellent job working on automobiles and lawnmower equipment at a reasonable price. He recently put brakes on our Toyota and replaced a broken engine mount, and hooked up a hose that had come off. With 217,000 miles it drives as good as the day I bought it. Try them. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Jimmy Yokel
reviews.text: update on my first review below: these guys are great. Charles helped walk me through the repairs done and the price was really reasonable. James did outstanding mechanic work and took great care of my truck. I would highly recommend these guys, don’t pass them up. they will do honest work with fair prices Charles is really helpful and stayed on the phone with me to diagnose issues with my chevy s10. he sent me over a quote and you could tell he genuinely cares for his customers. I would recommend him around the area without a doubt

reviews.author: Alejandra Torres
reviews.text: I’m new to the area and this place has excelent service and honest people. The car has some issues and they repair it within considerable time and price. I would definitly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Phillip Malphrus
reviews.text: Very professional and highly skilled servicing the rear differential on my 2014 Ford F150 STX and replacing my worn out rear brakes with new rotors and pads. They go the extra mile in ensuring the job is completed perfectly. They are honest, reasonable, and stand by their work.

reviews.author: Shelly
reviews.text: Talk about awesome customer service. I have taken 2 cars in and both times they went OVER AND BEYOND to get to the bottom of the issues. They also have great communication with the customer keeping them informed. I highly recommend going to see Charles and Dave for all of car issues. (Also, great for oil changes and tune ups) and it won't break the bank.

reviews.author: Christopher Orr
reviews.text: C&C Kustoms took good care of my car just in time for vacation! I wanted the AC checked out since it was coming out weak. These guys recharged it and made sure I didn't have any pressure leaks or compressor issues. They also did an induction cleaning and I finally got my serpentine belt and spark plugs replaced. Everything was done timely and for a great price! My car accelerates better and the AC feels great! I'll definitely be back in the future, especially since their shop is local. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Aliénor KAJDAS
reviews.text: Charles was super accommodating to make sure my car got taken care of quickly, he even offered me a ride back to work. He called me before doing anything to my car to explain what I needed and make sure I was okay with the amount it was going to be. The price he gave me on the phone was the price he charged me when I picked it up and was very reasonable. I would recommend anyone in the area to give them a call! I will definitely be back, thank you Charles!

reviews.author: Roberta Casaceli
reviews.text: I had a squeaking noise in one of my wheels so asked Charles to check it out. It turned out to be my brake pad. Charles and his crew fixed me up with new pads all around and got me feeling confident about my ride once again. Thank you for even picking up and delivering my car back to me after the service. Very pleased with this shop. Folks you can trust in an ever-increasingly dubious world! Roberta C.

reviews.author: Janice Gist
reviews.text: I am so thankful for Mr. Charles ,Dave and Cody. After taking my vehicle to the dealership several times and another automotive shop.where no one could tell me what was going on with my Buick, because it was cutting off on me while driving. I spent money on a battery, electrical panel and a transmission and the problem was still there. This has been going on for months and because no one could figure out what the problem was I was told to think about getting rid of it. My brother in law had taken his car to Mr.Charles and my nephew. So I decided to give him a try because I didn't have any where else to turn. I spoke with Mr. Charles on the phone .We talked for about 20 mins or more.I told him what was going on with my Buick. He asked a lot of questions and that's a good thing.He even told me his story and that made me believe that I was on the right path this time. Making a long story short Mr.Charles and his team has fixed my Buick .After going over my vehicle and asking all the right questions,they found the problem fixed it and didn't over charge me . I recommend this shop to anyone who is looking for some good honest people to fix your vehicle. Mr. Charles ,Dave and Cody are good honest people and I thank God for them.!!!

reviews.author: Steve Carlton
reviews.text: What can I say. Charles and Cody did a fantastic job making repairs on my 2019 Chevy Silverado 2500 hd. They replaced both upper control arms and the right rear axle seal. They’re very professional and greatly priced. Would and will do future business with them again. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Shaun Peterson
reviews.text: I’ve been looking for a mechanic that I could rely on since moving back to the Upstate area 2 years ago. After my first interaction with Cody and Charles I felt like I had finally found my people at C&C Kustoms. They treated me well, throughly explained everything that they wanted to do with my vehicle and provided follow up information as well. Really appreciate being seen and welcomed. If you’re looking for automotive repairs call here first. Thank you guys

reviews.author: Jimmy Attaway
reviews.text: Took my wife's SUV to Charles and Cody when another shop told me they could not fix my Maf issue and I would need to take it to a dealership and pay nearly $1000 for repairs. C&C diagnosed my issue and repaired it for a fraction of the price. These guys are the most honest mechanics you will find. I highly recommend them for any job. They will most definitely be my first call from now on.

reviews.author: Kayla Crittenden
reviews.text: Charles did a lot of work on my car, making it safe once again. I needed brakes, tires, and wipers. He did great on the repairs. Very knowledgeable and good customer service. Thank you!

reviews.author: Gerry Sandor
reviews.text: I'm new to the Greenville area, and finding C&C Kustoms was a blessing from God. I highly recommend them for their integrity to not stop researching until the problem is found, the automotive knowledge of the owner and his staff, and the high quality of work performed by his mechanics.

reviews.author: Terry Spearman
reviews.text: I highly recommend this shop. They are very knowledgeable and let you know before hand what they need to do to your vehicle. No hidden charges. Everything is up front. Also Charles is a good Christian man! I will definitely use them again. Prices are very reasonable!

reviews.author: RJ Gilbert
reviews.text: Charles was a Awsome dude . He helped me chase down a problem . And gave myself other options as well . He gave me very valuable information that i never thought of . They are my top choice. Thank you Charles

reviews.author: Bryan Sheriff
reviews.text: Great experience. Prices are always fair and explanation of repairs are always given and detailed. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: James McCoy
reviews.text: The owner knows what he's doing. Their prices are fair. Went in for a couple problems that were all fixed. I also got an induction cleaning and literally watched the engine smooth out and stop rattling in real time as it was running. 10/10

reviews.author: Regina Tucker
reviews.text: MR Charles & his team are honest, he kept me informed about what needed to be fixed. I love them all. Thank you.

reviews.author: Karim Nash
reviews.text: Communicated very clearly and helped me understand the process. Figured out the problem fast and sent me on my way . Reliable and affordable.

reviews.author: Ellie Basarabs
reviews.text: I took my truck here and they found the issue within minutes and gave me a great price to fix the issue. They went ahead and fixed it and I haven’t had an issue since. Most honest mechanic I’ve found around here and their pricing is wonderful!

reviews.author: Welcoming Spirits
reviews.text: I wanted a second opinion and I got it! Not only did he find the importance of what needs to be looked at and fixed, very kind people and love that it’s family owned! Highly recommend! He was also was detailed about explaining things, things the last place didn’t even point out that could be a fire hazard!!!

reviews.author: Rudy Barton
reviews.text: All of the guys at this shop are very knowledgeable and friendly. Great place to have automotive work done. God bless.

reviews.author: Timothy Moore
reviews.text: Top notch service..half the price of dealership...drove us back to hotel ..Thank you Charles for an amazing experience

reviews.author: Donna Miller
reviews.text: Honest and knowledgeable. Very reasonable. You’re in good hands with Charles and won’t be disappointed

reviews.author: Whitley 7_7
reviews.text: I can’t recommend C&C Kustoms enough! It’s hard to find mechanics who are truly honest, trustworthy, and genuinely care about their customers, but that’s exactly what you’ll find here. They had my car repaired in no time, and their customer service went above and beyond. They even picked my car up from my workplace and delivered it back to my house when it was finished, making the whole process incredibly convenient. If you’re looking for quality work from people with integrity who treat you like family, C&C Kustoms is the place to go. I’ll definitely be using them again and highly recommend them to anyone needing a mechanic!

reviews.author: Jeremy Hill
reviews.text: The BEST automotive repair place in SC PERIOD!!!! 2005 Toyota Tundra rust bucket needed a new engine, trans wire harness and gas tank strap and rusty frame repaired. Communication was clear and consice on next steps and what to expect. Truck is running and driving great! Will continue to be my auto repair go to for price and professional service.
